approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in current conversation, scoped only to the closed-allowlist payload-design architecture.
decision_scope: APPROVE_ONLY_THE_ARCHITECTURE_FOR_GOVERNING_CONTENT_OF_CONTROLLED_L03_DIRECT_QUESTION_CLAUSE; DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_ANY_ACTUAL_PAYLOAD, PROMOTE_PRODUCTIVITY, MAP_CURRICULUM, AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, UNLOCK_QA, GENERALIZE_KE, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, OR ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

design_decisions.statement: Define CONTROLLED_L03_DIRECT_QUESTION_CLAUSE as a CLOSED_ALLOWLIST of explicitly governed L03 direct-question clause patterns.
Start the allowlist empty; design approval authorizes no clause payload by itself.
Require a separate explicit payload candidate and validation before any pattern can enter the allowlist.
Do not admit STR001, STR002 or arbitrary clauses by default.
Keep AN/EN subject-person and KU/KUVAN content-interrogative lanes outside the initial payload contract.
After approval, open only a separate first payload candidate proposal gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Payload design approval is not payload authorization.
Payload design approval is not shell productivity promotion or curriculum mapping.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or arbitrary question wrapping is created.
No OPI/QA/STR003-STR005/runtime action; DARUNO/NELARA and HNK3000 remain untouched.
This approval stops before proposing, selecting or authorizing the first payload.
